scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Milk, Cheese,
Old Frying Pans,
Pieces of Cake...
Th-that's everything
I need to make lunch for
my friends in the Factory!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
牛奶、奶酪、
破旧平底锅、
蛋糕块...
这...这些就是我
为工厂里的朋友们
做午餐所需的全部食材了！

scripts.text: Well, I did promise to help you.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我答应过要帮你的。

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Finally, I can treat my
buddies to a wonderful
feast! They'll be so pleased!
Oh, I'd really like to repay you
somehow, but I'm not sure
what I could possibly give...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
太好了，我终于可以
请我的伙伴们享用
一顿丰盛的午餐了！
他们一定会很开心的！
啊，我真想好好报答你，
但我不确定能给你什么...

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Of course! Why don't
you treat yourself to
my specialty, Kasis's
Crunch Toast? It looks
simple, but it actually
requires great skill to make.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
当然！不如你尝尝
我的拿手好戏，卡西斯的
土司吧？它看起来很简单，
但其实制作起来非常考验技巧。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Here you are!
Please enjoy this and always
remember that breakfast is the
most important meal of the day!
Now, I better prepare those
lunches. Goodbye, my friend~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
给你！
请享用，并永远记住
早餐是一天中最重要的一餐！
好了，我得去准备午餐了。
再见，我的朋友~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Oh...
Oh, I'm so sorry.
I must have confused
you with someone else.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
啊...
啊，真对不起。
我一定是把你
和别的人搞混了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
You see, I've been asking
adventurers that have been
passing through to provide
me with food supplies so that
I can make lunch for my friends
that are working in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你看，我一直在请求
路过的冒险者
为我提供食材，
这样我就能为在艾音布罗克
工厂工作的朋友们做午餐了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Yes...
So...
Sorry...
To... Bother you.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
是的...
所以...
抱歉...
打扰...你了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs if entranced,
Kasis continues to
stare at the Milk, Cheese
Old Frying Pans and Pieces
of Cake that you are carrying.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF卡西斯仿佛着了魔一般，
一直盯着你携带的牛奶、奶酪、
破旧平底锅和蛋糕块看。^000000

scripts.text: You can have these if you want.
scripts.translation: 如果你想要的话，这些给你吧。

scripts.text: Um, why are you staring?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你为什么一直盯着看？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Really? Is it alright
with you for me to have
all of this Milk, Cheese,
Pieces of Cake and these
Old Frying Pans? Oh, bless
your kind heart, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
真的吗？你愿意把这些
牛奶、奶酪、蛋糕块
和破旧平底锅都给我吗？
啊，谢谢你，心地善良的冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Finally, I can treat my
buddies to a wonderful
feast! They'll be so pleased!
Oh, I'd really like to repay you
somehow, but I'm not sure
what I could possibly give...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
太好了，我终于可以
请我的伙伴们享用
一顿丰盛的午餐了！
他们一定会很开心的！
啊，我真想好好报答你，
但我不确定能给你什么...

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Of course! Why don't
you treat yourself to
my specialty, Kasis's
Crunch Toast? It looks
simple, but it actually
requires great skill to make.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
当然！不如你尝尝
我的拿手好戏，卡西斯的
土司吧？它看起来很简单，
但其实制作起来非常考验技巧。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Here you are!
Please enjoy this and always
remember that breakfast is the
most important meal of the day!
Now, I better prepare those
lunches. Goodbye, my friend~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
给你！
请享用，并永远记住
早餐是一天中最重要的一餐！
好了，我得去准备午餐了。
再见，我的朋友~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Oh, let me apologize
again. But I can't help
but admire the quality of
your goods. Er, you know,
the food you're carrying. I'm
a chef by trade, after all.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
啊，让我再向你道歉一次。
但我忍不住要夸赞一下
你货物的品质。呃，你知道的，
就是你携带的那些食物。毕竟，
我是以厨师为职业的。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm sorry, but we're closed
right now. Unfortunately, we
don't have any more bread
in stock. ^333333*Siiiiiiiiigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
很抱歉，我们现在已经打烊了。
不幸的是，我们的面包
已经卖光了。^333333*唉...*^000000

scripts.text: Is something wrong?
scripts.translation: 出什么事了吗？

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Well, my current contract
with the company that's been
providing me with ingredients
has expired. Of course, it's
bad enough that I don't have
the food to run this business.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
嗯，我和一直为我提供食材的
公司之间的契约已经到期了。
当然，没有食物来维持
这家店的经营已经很糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
But I also feel like I'm
letting my friends down.
You see, I've been sending
them lunch every day since
they've been working in the
Factory over in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
但我也觉得自己在
辜负我的朋友们。
你看，自从他们在艾音布罗克
的工厂工作以来，
我每天都给他们送午餐。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm unable to make
lunch for them at the
moment, but I really want to
help my buddies, especially
since their financial situation
seems pretty bad right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我现在无法为他们
做午餐了，但我真的很想
帮助我的伙伴们，
特别是他们现在的经济状况
似乎很糟糕。

scripts.text: Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation: 需要我帮你吗？

scripts.text: I'm so sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation: 听到这个我很难过。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Sure, I'm willing to accept
help from wherever I can find
it. If you would, I'd like you to bring me some food supplies
that I can use to make lunches
for my friends at the Factory.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
当然，我愿意接受任何能找到的帮助。
如果可以的话，希望你能帮我带一些食材，
这样我就能为工厂里的朋友们做午餐了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Would you
please get me
^4D4DFF50 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Cheese^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Pieces of Cake^000000 and
^4D4DFF50 Old Frying Pans^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
请帮我买
^4D4DFF50牛奶^000000、
^4D4DFF50奶酪^000000、
^4D4DFF50蛋糕块^000000和
^4D4DFF50破旧平底锅^000000，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'd really appreciate
your help. My friends seem
so depressed to be working
in the Factory and I want to
do all I can to cheer them up.
Thanks for your kind offer~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
非常感谢你的帮助。我的朋友们在工厂工作
看起来很沮丧，我想尽我所能让他们开心起来。
谢谢你的好意~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm trying to renew
my contract with the
company that's been
providing me with food
supplies, but it hasn't
been working out so far...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我正在尝试与一直为我提供食材的
公司续约，但到目前为止进展不太顺利...

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I don't know what's
happening, but hopefully
I can find a new supplier
soon. There are my friends
to worry about, as well as
the sake of my business.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我不知道发生了什么，但希望
我很快能找到新的供应商。我不仅要担心
我的朋友们，还要为了我的生意着想。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Anyway, please come
again. Hopefully, we'll
have some good bread
in stock next time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
总之，请再来吧。希望下次
我们会有好吃的面包存货，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
Wait! Don't say
anything! You must be
an adventurer from the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
So... I'm right, aren't I?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的家伙]
等等！别说话！你一定是
来自卢恩·米德加兹王国的冒险者！
所以...我猜对了吧？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: How did you know?
scripts.translation: 你怎么知道的？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Allow me to
introduce myself.
My name is Morris Poe,
detective of great acclaim
and world wide fame.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
请允许我
自我介绍。
我叫莫里斯·坡，
享誉盛名、名扬四海的侦探。

scripts.text: I've never heard of you.
scripts.translation: 我从未听说过你。

scripts.text: You're kidding me.
scripts.translation: 你在开玩笑吧。

scripts.text: I'm outta here.
scripts.translation: 我要走了。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Morris Poe?
Renown detective?
Advocate for justice in
the Schwarzwald Republic?
Surely you recognize one
of my esteemed titles.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
莫里斯·坡？
著名的侦探？
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的
正义捍卫者？
你肯定能认出我的
其中一个头衔吧。

scripts.text: Nope, I don't know you.
scripts.translation: 不，我不认识你。

scripts.text: You're Morris Poe?!
scripts.translation: 你是莫里斯·坡？！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
You don't...?
But I'm a famous hero.
Children look up to me
and wish they'd grow
up to be as smart as me.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
你不...？
但我可是个著名的英雄。
孩子们都崇拜我，
希望长大后能像我一样聪明。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
I don't get it.
I'm famouser than
that. A household name
even. I've got a sterling
public image, how could
you never have heard of me...?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
我不明白。
我比那还要有名。
甚至是家喻户晓的名字。
我的公众形象无可挑剔，
你怎么可能从未听说过我...？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Kidding? Ha ha!
Look at these keen,
deductive and deeply
analytical eyes and
tell me I'm joking.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
开玩笑？哈哈！
看看我这双敏锐、
善于推理且分析透彻的眼睛，
告诉我我在开玩笑。

scripts.text: Whoa, those ARE keen eyes.
scripts.translation: 哇，那确实是双敏锐的眼睛。

scripts.text: Okay. You're joking.
scripts.translation: 好吧。你在开玩笑。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Yes, this sharp,
penetrating, yet
highly intelligent gaze
belongs to the world
detective and crime
fighter, Morris Poe!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
是的，这双锐利、
洞察力强且
极具智慧的目光，
属于世界侦探兼犯罪克星，
莫里斯·坡！

scripts.text: I've never heard of you.
scripts.translation: 我从未听说过你。

scripts.text: Golly, Morris Poe?!
scripts.translation: 天哪，莫里斯·坡？！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Never heard of...?
Impossible! If there are
two things I hate more
than crime, they would be
dishonesty... And rejection
from beautiful women.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
从未听说过...？
不可能！如果有什么比犯罪更让我讨厌的，那就是不诚实...还有被美丽的女性拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
When you get over your
sense of pride and gain
a little maturity, then we
might share an actual
conversation. Until then,
you'll just have to grow up.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
等你放下你的自尊心，变得稍微成熟一点，我们也许就能进行真正的对话了。在那之前，你最好先长大成人。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahahahahaah--Huh.
If there are two things
I hate more than criminals,
they would be sarcasm...
And receiving fake phone
numbers from really cute girls.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哈哈哈哈——嗯。
如果有什么比罪犯更让我讨厌的，那就是讽刺...还有收到真正可爱的女孩给的假电话号码。

scripts.text: Yeah, you're no Don Juan.
scripts.translation: 是啊，你可不是唐·璜。

scripts.text: I'm... I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 我...我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Wah...!
Did you just--?!
Ugh, you're the worst
type of person, you know that?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哇...！
你刚才...？！
唉，你知道你这种人最糟糕吗？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
I think it's too late to
apologize. Why would you
treat someone of my stature
with such caustic sarcasm?!
What excuse could possibly
exonerate your behavior?!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
我觉得现在道歉已经太晚了。你为什么要用如此尖刻的讽刺来对待像我这样地位的人？！
有什么借口能证明你的行为是无辜的吗？！

scripts.text: I... I was intimidated...
scripts.translation: 我...我很害怕...

scripts.text: It's how I treat all losers.
scripts.translation: 这就是我对所有失败者的态度。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Of course: intense feelings
of awe and fear of my vast
intellect would result in that
kind of deviant behavior. I'll
have to forgive you, I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
当然：对我渊博学识的敬畏和恐惧导致了这种变态行为。我想我还是得原谅你吧。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
What...?!
Morris Poe, a loser?
Such defamatory remarks
cannot be forgiven, no
matter how unfounded
and groundless they are!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
什么...？！
莫里斯·坡，一个失败者？
这种诽谤性的言论是绝对不能被原谅的，无论它多么毫无根据！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahaha, oh, that's
funny. Wait. You're...
You're really leaving.
N-no, come baaaack!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哈哈，哦，这真有趣。等等。你是...
你真的要走了。
不...不，回...回来！

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
How did I know?
Elementary, my friend.
There was an abundance
of clues for me to make
that sort of simple deduction.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的家伙]
我怎么会知道？
很简单，我的朋友。
有大量的线索让我做出了这种简单的推理。

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
Hello...?
...............
Oh, this is embarassing.
I can't believe I'm getting
the silent treatment...
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的家伙]
你好...？
...............
哦，这太尴尬了。
我简直不敢相信我正在被冷遇...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Yes, I know it's
difficult to believe that
you would be fortunate
enough to stand in the
presence of genius. Now,
you must be wondering...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
是的，我知道很难相信你有幸能站在天才面前。现在，你一定在想...

scripts.text: Um, wondering what?
scripts.translation: 嗯，在想什么？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
You're wondering,
"How in the world
can I be as brilliant
as Morris Poe, the
genius detective?"
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
你在想，
“我怎么可能像天才侦探莫里斯·坡一样聪明？”

scripts.text:
[Morris]
First, I think it's fair
to let you know that it's
an impossible dream. Men like
myself only arise in this world
perhaps once every generation.
I'm sorry, but don't give up!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
首先，我觉得让你知道这是一个不可能的梦想是公平的。像我这样的人，在这个世界上一代可能只会出现一次。
很抱歉，但不要放弃！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Now, you can try to reach
a level of intelligence that
is comparable to my own by
joining the Young Detective's
Club. To become a member, you just need one essential article.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
现在，你可以通过加入少年侦探社来尝试达到与我相当的智慧水平。要成为会员，你只需要一件必备物品。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Yes, you will need the
^0000FFRenown Detective's Cap^000000!
Luckily, I'm giving them
away for a relatively small
material cost, but you must
hurry while supplies last.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
是的，你需要
^0000FF侦探之帽^000000！
幸运的是，我只收取
相对低廉的材料费，
但你要抓紧，数量有限。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Simply bring me
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. That's all!

[Morris]
But first, let me warn you
not to bring a ^FF0000slotted Bucket
Hat with a card compounded to
it, or any upgraded Bucket Hats. I'm not responsible for any
loss resulting from that.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
不过首先，我要提醒你，不要携带^FF0000带有插槽且镶嵌了卡片的软呢帽，或者任何升级过的软呢帽。如果因此造成损失，我概不负责。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hurry and bring me
those items! There are
only 20,000,000 Renown
Detective Caps left!
Once they're gone,
they'll be extinct!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
快把那些物品带给我！
只剩下20,000,000顶
侦探之帽了！
一旦卖完，
就绝版了！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
So, did you want to
buy, er, receive this
Renown Detective's Cap
and become an honored
member of the Young
Detective's Club?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
那么，你是想
购买，呃，领取这顶
侦探之帽，
并成为少年侦探社
的荣誉成员吗？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember, make sure
that you don't bring any
^FF0000slotted Bucket Hats that
have been upgraded or have
cards compounded to them, or
you'll lose those enhancements^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
记住，确保你带来的
^FF0000软呢帽没有升级，
也没有镶嵌卡片^000000，
否则你会失去那些强化效果。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Now, if you have only
1 Bucket Hat, we can begin.
Young Detective's Club... Salute!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
现在，如果你只有
1顶软呢帽，我们可以开始了。
少年侦探社...敬礼！

scripts.text: Salute.
scripts.translation: 敬礼

scripts.text: Whatever...
scripts.translation: 随便吧...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great, done like a pro!
Now, I need to check your
fee--I mean qualifications.
Let's see now, I need to
look through your Inventory...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好，做得像专业人士一样！
现在，我需要检查你的
费用——我是说资格。
让我看看，我需要
翻查一下你的物品栏...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Wait. You don't have
enough Magnifiers. You
do want to join this club,
don't you? Did you need to
hear the requirements again?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
等等。你的放大镜不够。
你是想加入这个社团的，
对吧？需要我再
说一遍要求吗？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Not enough Tassels? Check.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜。有。
流苏不够？有。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Hm. You're missing
the slotted Bucket Hat.
You were so close...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜。有。
流苏...有。
嗯。你缺少软呢帽。
你差一点就成功了...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Hey. Where's the zeny?!
That's the most important,
er, qualification of all!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜。有。
流苏...有。
软呢帽。有。
嘿。Zeny呢？！
那是最重要的，
呃，资格之一！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
^333333*Sigh*^000000 You need
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. That's all!

[Morris]
Now, remember everything
that you need this time, okay?
I'll be waiting to welcome
you into the elite ranks of 
the Young Detective's Club.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
现在，这次记住
你需要的所有东西，好吗？
我会在这里等待，
欢迎你加入少年侦探社
的精英行列。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Aaaand zeny. Heh heh. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜。有。
流苏...有。
软呢帽。有。
还有Zeny。嘿嘿。完美。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great, that's everything!
Welcome to the club! Here's
your Renown Detective's Cap,
so wear it with pride as you
take an active part in our club's
activities and promotion!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好，都齐了！
欢迎加入社团！这是
你的侦探之帽，
请自豪地戴上它，
积极参与我们社团的
活动和宣传！

scripts.text: Wait, promotion?
scripts.translation: 等等，宣传？

scripts.text: Hooray!
scripts.translation: 万岁！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Of course, isn't it obvious?
As a member, one of your duties
will be to sing accolades of this club so that more members
will join and earn their own
Renown Detective's Caps.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
当然，这不是显而易见的吗？
作为成员，你的职责之一
就是歌颂这个社团，
以便吸引更多成员加入，
并获得他们自己的
侦探之帽。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Alright, scurry off
now and proudly display
your new, rakishly stylish
Renown Detective's Cap
to all of your friends!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好了，快去吧！
向你的朋友们炫耀一下
你那顶崭新、潇洒又帅气的
侦探之帽吧！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Alright, scurry off
now and proudly display
your new, rakishly stylish
Renown Detective's Cap
to all of your friends!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好了，快去吧！
向你的朋友们炫耀一下
你那顶崭新、潇洒又帅气的
侦探之帽吧！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Huh. You just failed
the "Test of Respect."
You don't deserve the
honor of wearing the
Renowned Detective's Cap!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哼。你刚才
没有通过“尊重测试”。
你不配拥有
佩戴著名侦探之帽的
荣誉！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Have you come to me
in order to obtain another
Renown Detective's Cap?
I realize that such a stylish
headgear is in high demand.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
你是来找我
再获取一顶
侦探之帽的吗？
我知道这种时尚的头饰
非常抢手。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember, make sure
that you don't bring any
^FF0000slotted Bucket Hats that
have been upgraded or have
cards compounded to them, or
you'll lose those enhancements^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
记住，确保你带来的
^FF0000软呢帽没有升级，
也没有镶嵌卡片^000000，
否则你会失去那些强化效果。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
As a proud member of
the Young Detective's Club,
did you bring everything
you need in order to earn
a Renown Detective's Cap?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
作为少年侦探社
自豪的一员，
你带齐了获得
侦探之帽所需的
所有东西了吗？

scripts.text: I'm not sure~
scripts.translation: 我不太确定~

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
What...?! Every good
detective must have a
photographic memory
and be able to recall
minute details in order
to crack the case.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
什...什么？！
优秀的侦探必须拥有
过目不忘的记忆力，
并能回忆起细微的细节，
才能破案。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember...
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. Okay?

[Morris]
Great!
Now let me just
check to see if you
brought everything...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好！
现在让我检查一下
你是否带齐了所有东西...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hmm, you don't have
enough Magnifiers? But
those are essential tools
for sleuthing. Come now,
hurry back with them!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
嗯，你的放大镜
不够吗？但那是
侦探必不可少的工具。
快去吧，赶紧把它们带回来！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Not enough Tassels? Check.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜。有。
流苏不够？有。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Hm. You're missing
the slotted Bucket Hat.
You were so close...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜。有。
流苏...有。
嗯。你缺少软呢帽。
你差一点就成功了...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Hey. Where's the zeny?!
That's the most important,
er, qualification of all!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜。有。
流苏...有。
软呢帽。有。
嘿。Zeny呢？！
那是最重要的，
呃，资格之一！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember...
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. Okay?

[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Aaaand zeny. Heh heh. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大镜。有。
流苏...有。
软呢帽。有。
还有Zeny。嘿嘿。完美。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great! You've just qualified
to own yet another Renowned
Detective's Cap. Congratulations! Now, let me collect all of these
goods and zeny from you...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好！你刚刚获得了
拥有另一顶著名侦探之帽的资格。
恭喜！现在，让我把这些
物品和Zeny收起来...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahaha! It's what
I expect from one of
our Junior Gold Members!
How does it feel like to be
the cream of the cream of
the crop? Great, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哈哈！这正是我对
我们“黄金会员”的期待！
成为顶尖中的顶尖，
感觉如何？很棒，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hello, mister!
Um, would you do
me a favor, please?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你好，先生！
那个，能请你帮
我个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hello, ma'am!
Um, would you do
me a favor, please?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你好，女士！
那个，能请你帮
我个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh! You brought me
some Royal Jelly to
eat, as well as everything
I need to make a Baby Pacifier.
Okay, let me get started on that right away. Just a moment...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦！你不仅给我带了
蜂胶吃，还带齐了
制作小孩奶嘴所需的一切。
好的，我马上开始做。请稍等...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Damn.
That Royal Jelly
was frickin' delicious!
Now I can make your
Baby Pacifier. Let's see
here. Ah, here we go...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
该死。
那蜂胶真是
美味极了！
现在我可以为你制作
小孩奶嘴了。让我看看。
啊，开始了...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
It's done!
Now, you're the
proud owner of your
very own Baby Pacifier!
I hope you're happy with
yourself. Travel safe, okay?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
完成了！
现在，你拥有了
属于自己的小孩奶嘴！
希望你满意。一路顺风，好吗？

scripts.text: What do you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什么？

scripts.text: Sorry, kid...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，小家伙...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Well, my mom has been
sick recently, so both of
us haven't been able to eat
for the past few days. But
if she doesn't eat, how does
she expect to get better?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯，我妈妈最近生病了，
所以我们好几天都没吃东西了。
但如果她不吃东西，
怎么能好起来呢？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
So I guess what I'm
asking is, would you be
able to spare some food?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
所以我想问的是，
你能分我一点食物吗？

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 帮助他。

scripts.text: Refuse to help.
scripts.translation: 拒绝帮助。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
If you would, do you think
you can get some Royal Jelly
that I can give to my mom? The old lady next door says that it's
really nutritious and helps you get better faster if you're sick.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
如果可以的话，
你能帮我弄点蜂胶吗？
我想给我妈妈吃。
隔壁的老太太说，
蜂胶营养很好，
生病的时候吃了能好得快一些。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
My mom would be mad
at me if she found out
I was begging for it, but
Royal Jelly is too expensive
for me to get without any help!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
如果我妈妈知道
我在求人帮忙，
她肯定会生气的，
但蜂胶对我来说太贵了，
不靠别人我根本买不起！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh, would it be alright
if I have this Royal Jelly?
It would really help my mom
feel better. Thanks so much~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
啊，那我可以收下
这个蜂胶吗？
它真的能让我妈妈
感觉好一些。太感谢了~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey, to pay you back, why
don't I make a Baby Pacifier
for you? I learned how to make
one when my baby brother was
born. But first, I'll need some
materials to put it together...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿，为了报答你，
我为你做一个小孩奶嘴吧？
我弟弟出生时，
我学会了怎么做。
不过首先，
我需要一些材料来组装它...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Would you
please bring
^3131FF1 Nursing Bottle^000000,
^3131FF1 Nose Ring^000000 and
^3131FF1 Pacifier^000000? Oh, and one
more ^3131FFRoyal Jelly^000000 for me~

[Kid]
Oh... Um, that's
alright. Maybe I was
asking too much from
you. I mean, it's true
that you barely know me...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦...嗯，
没关系。也许是我
要求太多了。
毕竟，你几乎不认识我...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Th-that's okay.
I guess you must
be so busy that you
don't even have the
time to listen to some
little boy's problems...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
那...那好吧。
我想你一定很忙，
连听一个小男孩
烦恼的时间都没有...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Oh, hello, what's this?
You're carrying 1 Black
Dyestuffs, 1 Frozen Rose,
999 Tiger Panties and even
50,000 zeny with you. That's
enough to make a Winter Hat...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
哦，你好，这是什么？
你身上带着1个黑色染料、
1朵冰雕玫瑰、
999条老虎内裤，
甚至还有50,000 Zeny。
这些足够做一顶时尚防寒帽了...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Um, would you mind letting
me have those items so that
I can make a Winter Hat?
I'd never be able to gather
those things on my own...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
嗯，你介意把这些材料
给我吗？
这样我就能做一顶时尚防寒帽了。
我自己根本凑不齐
这些东西...

scripts.text: Let her have the items.
scripts.translation: 把材料给她。

scripts.text: Don't give her the items.
scripts.translation: 不给材料。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Oh, thank you so much!
I've always wanted to make
this hat and try it on, even
if it's just once. But don't
worry, I'll give it to you~
Now please next; a moment...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
哦，太感谢了！
我一直想做这顶帽子
并试戴一下，
哪怕只有一次也好。
不过别担心，我会把它给你的~
那么请等一下，稍候片刻...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Let's see...
I've got to fold
the rose like this...
Be careful with the dye...
Where did I put all those
pan--Oh, here we are.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
让我看看...
我得把玫瑰这样折叠...
小心染料...
我把那些布料放哪了--
哦，在这里。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
^333333*Whew!*^000000
Finally, it's done!
Now, if you don't mind,
let me try this hat on
for just a little while.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
^333333*呼！^000000
终于做好了！
如果你不介意的话，
让我先试戴这顶帽子
一小会儿。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Ahhhhhh~
It just feels...
I felt so free~
It was everything
I imagined it to be.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
啊~~~~~
感觉就是...
我感到无比自由~
它完全就是我
想象中的样子。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Here, please take
this Winter Hat. I really
hope that you'll enjoy it
as much as I do. Well then,
be safe in your travels, okay?
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
请收下这顶时尚防寒帽。
我真的希望你能
像我一样喜欢它。
那么，旅途平安，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
I'm sorry, I know that
I was asking a pretty big
favor from someone I just
met. I hope you understand
how much I really want to
make that Winter Hat...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
对不起，我知道
我刚才向一个刚认识的人
提出了很大的请求。
希望你能理解我
有多想做那顶时尚防寒帽...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Look at that blue
sky. Don't you wish
you could just soar
through the heavens
with your own wings?
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
看那片蓝天。
你不希望
能长出翅膀，
在天空中翱翔吗？

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Of course, it's an
impossible dream,
but with this Winter Hat,
you can at least enjoy the
sensation of freedom that
a bird in flight must feel.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
当然，这是一个
不可能的梦想，
但戴上这顶时尚防寒帽，
你至少能感受到
鸟儿飞翔时
那种自由的感觉。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
If you would like
a hat like this, I would
need to have some items
that I don't think I can ever
obtain on my very own.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
如果您想要一顶这样的帽子，
我需要一些材料，
但我认为凭我自己
是永远也弄不到的。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
^FF00001 Black Dyestuffs^000000,
^FF0000999 Tiger Panties^000000,
^FF00001 Frozen Rose^000000 and
^FF000050,000 zeny^000000. If you can
bring those to me, I shall
make you a Winter Hat.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
^FF00001 黑色染料^000000，
^FF0000999 老虎内裤^000000，
^FF00001 冰雕玫瑰^000000 以及
^FF000050,000 Zeny^000000。
如果您能将这些带给我，
我就为您制作一顶时尚防寒帽。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
The white rose, in its
purity and simplicity, is
like a woman who doesn't
need jewels or fancy dresses
to look noble and beautiful. It's the perfect gift for a lady.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
白玫瑰以其纯洁与简约，
宛如一位无需珠宝或华服
便能显得高贵美丽的淑女。
它是送给女士的完美礼物。

scripts.text: Make a Mystic Rose.
scripts.translation: 制作水灵玫瑰

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Ah, I see that you've brought
what I need to bleach the blood
red hue from these Witherless
Roses and adorn these flowers
with eternal elegance. May I use these items to make a Mystic Rose?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
啊，看来您带来了
我需要的材料，
可以将这些永恒玫瑰上的
血红褪去，
赋予花朵永恒的优雅。
我可以开始制作水灵玫瑰了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Thank you. Please
next; a moment while
I concentrate in order to
preserve the natural beauty
of these gorgeous flowers...
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
谢谢。请稍等，
我需要集中精神，
以保留这些美丽花朵
原本的自然之美...

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
The rose truly is the
undisputed queen of all
flowers. All other flora must
humbly bow to its regal beauty.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
玫瑰无疑是
百花之王。
其他所有花卉
都必须向它尊贵的
美丽低头致敬。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
There, it is finished.
Please remember to wear
your hair in an elegant and
refined manner when wearing
the Mystic Rose so as not to disgrace these beautiful flowers.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
好了，完成了。
佩戴水灵玫瑰时，
请务必将头发梳理得
优雅精致，
以免玷污了这些美丽的花朵。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
White roses with thorns
makes my heart beat with
unceasing trepidation. What
if I prick my finger and shed
blood on its snow white petals?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
带刺的白玫瑰
让我心跳加速，
充满无尽的忐忑。
万一我刺破了手指，
鲜血滴落在
雪白的花瓣上怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
I love roses, but it makes
me sad that their beauty
fades far too soon. And so,
I've found a way to preserve
the beauty of the roses, so
that it lasts for all eternity.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
我爱玫瑰，
但它们的
美丽消逝得太快，
这让我感到悲伤。
因此，我找到了一种方法，
可以保留玫瑰的美丽，
使其永恒不灭。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Do you love roses as well?
If you like, I can make a
^3131FFMystic Rose^000000 that you can wear
upon your crown. It's not easy
for me to create, but I believe that you would enjoy it greatly.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
您也爱玫瑰吗？
如果您愿意，
我可以为您制作一朵
^3131FF水灵玫瑰^000000，
戴在您的发间。
制作它并不容易，
但我相信您会非常喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Please bring me
^3131FF10 2 Carat Diamonds^000000,
^3131FF3 Witherless Roses^000000,
^3131FF1 White Dyestuffs^000000 and
^3131FF50,000 zeny^000000 if you would
like to have a Mystic Rose.
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
如果您想要一朵水灵玫瑰，
请带给我
^3131FF10 颗 2克拉钻石^000000，
^3131FF3 朵 永恒玫瑰^000000，
^3131FF1 个 白色染料^000000 以及
^3131FF50,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
White roses with thorns
makes my heart beat with
unceasing trepidation. What
if I prick my finger and shed
blood on its snow white petals?
scripts.translation:
[玛格丽特·玛丽]
带刺的白玫瑰
让我心跳加速，
充满无尽的忐忑。
万一我刺破了手指，
鲜血滴落在
雪白的花瓣上怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Relaxed-Looking Lady]
Hmmm...?
What? Did you
need something?
scripts.translation:
[神情悠闲的女士]
嗯...？
什么？
您有什么事吗？

scripts.text: N-Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没...没什么。

scripts.text: Um, you look so relaxed.
scripts.translation: 那个，您看起来很悠闲。

scripts.text:
[Relaxed-Looking Lady]
Huh.
Alright then.
Well, try not to stare

燃烧着嗜血的本能！

充满爱意的鞭子一样！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Zealotus...
She must be pissed
at me, but I just can't
stop being afraid of all
you humans! Damn it all!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
泽洛图斯...
她肯定在生我的气，
但我就是忍不住
害怕你们这些人类！
该死啊！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Y-you again!
Why do you hound me?!
Th-there's nothing I can
give you, so please don't
hurt me! Oh, oh p-please...!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
又...又是你！
你为什么非要纠缠我？！
我...我没有什么能给你的，
求求你别伤害我！
求求你...别这样...

scripts.text: Feed him Dark Crystal Fragment.
scripts.translation: 喂他黑色水晶碎片

scripts.text: Threaten him.
scripts.translation: 威胁他

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
What...? You want
me to eat these?
It doesn't seem natural,
but if Rybio says I should,
it might not be that bad.
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
什...什么？你想
让我吃这些？
虽然看起来很不自然，
但如果里比奥说应该吃，
那可能也没那么糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
What's supposed to
happen now? My inner
demon is supposed to
awaken by eating these?
That sounds ridiculous!
Though, I did just eat crystal.
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
接下来会发生什么？
吃了这些，我体内的
恶魔就会觉醒吗？
这听起来太荒谬了！
不过，我刚才确实吃了水晶。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Wh-whoa. Ugh!
My chest! Something's
burning inside! I c-can't--!
Can't think straight... I'm...
Slowly... Losing my humanity!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
哇...唔！
我的胸口！里面
有什么在燃烧！我...我撑不住--！
脑子一片空白...我...
正在...失去人性！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Huh... Huuurg--!
Huk-huk! Heeeeh!
Heeeeeh! Waaoooooh!

[Phendark]
...
Grrrrr...!

[Phendark]
^333333*Pant pant*^000000
What... just...
What happened?

[{0}]
So what happens
if I don't decide not
to hurt you? Whatcha
gonna do then, huh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果我决定
不伤害你呢？
那你打算怎么办，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
S-stop it!
Just--Just stop it!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
停...停下！
求你...求你停下！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Humans...
They're everywhere!
You guys--I can't...
You're torturing me!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
人类...
到处都是！
你们这些家伙--我受不了了...
你们在折磨我！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
My chest was on fire,
like I was, I dunno,
burning with anger or
something. It's gone
now, but what were
those crystals?
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
我的胸口像着了火一样，
就像...我不知道，
像是被愤怒吞噬。
现在感觉消失了，
但那些水晶是什么？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
You again? Oh no,
you're not going to hurt
me or make me eat those
weird crystals again, are you?
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
又是你？天哪，
你不会又要伤害我，
或者逼我吃那些
奇怪的水晶吧？

scripts.text: Zealotus.

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
I don't think
congratulations are
in order, but I guess
that's good news to hear.
Still, what a surprise!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
我觉得现在说恭喜还为时过早，
不过听到这个好消息也不错。
真是令人惊讶啊！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Hey...!
I don't know if
that's something
I want to hear about!
[{0}]
First of all,
what exactly sets
you apart from all the
other eligible monsters
that she can choose from?
Not like you're much better...
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
嘿...！
我可不想听这种事！
[{0}]
首先，
你和其他那些她可以挑选的
合格魔物相比，
到底有什么特别之处？
你也没好到哪里去...

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Hey...!
I don't know if
that's something
I want to hear about!
[{0}]
I...
I was just kidding!
How could she hate
somebody like you?
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
嘿...！
我可不想听这种事！
[{0}]
我...
我开玩笑的！
她怎么可能憎恨你这样的人？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Hey...!
I don't know if
that's something
I want to hear about!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
嘿...！
我可不想听这种事！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
I can't believe
something like that!
Oh, that doesn't matter.
Zealotus is too good for me.
I'm not even worthy of tasting
the sting of her Love Whip.
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
我简直不敢相信！
哦，这并不重要。
泽洛图斯对我来说太优秀了。
我甚至不配品尝她爱之鞭的刺痛。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
...
......
Hates me?
N-no, that can't--
I didn't, that doesn't--
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
...
......
憎恨我？
不...不可能——
我没有，那不可能——

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Huh...?
What is that
supposed to mean?
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
嗯...？
这是什么意思？

scripts.text: Insult him.
scripts.translation: 侮辱他

scripts.text: Apologize.
scripts.translation: 道歉

scripts.text:
[{0}]
First of all,

[{0}]

合格魔物相比，
到底有什么特别之处？
你也没好到哪里去...

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
...
......
Break his pride.
scripts.translation: 打击他的自尊心

scripts.text: Tell him you were joking.
scripts.translation: 告诉他你在开玩笑

scripts.text:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
I mean, there are guys
like Bloody Murderer out
there who are more evil
than you, and best of all,
not afraid of humans!
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
我是说，外面有像嗜血怪人
那样比你更邪恶的家伙，
而且最重要的是，
他们不怕人类！

scripts.text: Go for the low blow.
scripts.translation: 进行人身攻击

scripts.text: Try to salvage his confidence.
scripts.translation: 试图挽回他的自信

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know, me and Zealotus
were actually talking about
you recently. She told me that
the sight of you makes her
feel sick! I mean, what kind
of monster is afraid of humans?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道吗，我和泽洛图斯最近
其实一直在谈论你。她说
看到你就觉得恶心！我是说，
什么样的魔物会害怕人类啊？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now you've reached the
point where even Injustice
is manlier than you now,
if you know what I mean!
Hahahahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在你甚至变得
比邪恶使者还缺乏男子气概了，
如果你懂我意思的话！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
...
......

[Phendark]
GRRRRRR!
THAT'S ENOUGH!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
格RRRRRR！
够了！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
I don't care who the
hell she is, I'm going
to see Zealotus and give
that tramp a piece of my
mind! Grrrr! She'll be sorry!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
我不管她是谁，
我要去找泽洛图斯，
给那个荡妇一点颜色看看！
格！她死定了！

scripts.text:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
But know that I think
about it, maybe you look
much tougher than that
Bloody Murderer guy.
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
不过话说回来，
也许你看起来
比那个嗜血怪人还要凶悍。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
*Sniff sniff*
You really think so?
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
*吸鼻子*
你...真的这么觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Yeeeeeah.

[{0}]
But now that I think
about it, you actually
are much better than all
those other monsters.
That stuff I said before?
I was just kidding you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过仔细想想，
你其实比那些魔物
都要强得多。
我刚才说的话？
我只是在逗你玩。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
^333333*Sniff!*^000000
You're...
Not helping!

[{0}]
I...
I was just kidding!
How could she hate
somebody like you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...
我只是在开玩笑！
她怎么可能
讨厌像你这样的人呢？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
No... No.
You're right.
I don't deserve love.
Not from Zealotus or
from anybody else...
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
不...不。
你说得对。
我不配得到爱。
无论是来自泽洛图斯
还是其他人...

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Zealotus! How dare
she say those things
against me! Less manly
than Injustice?! I'll just
have to prove her wrong!
Out the way, pithy human!
scripts.translation:
[芬达克]
泽洛图斯！她竟敢
那样说我！比邪恶使者
还缺乏男子气概？！
我一定要证明她是错的！
让开，渺小的人类！

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
You know, I usually just
run up and slash like crazy
once I see you humans, but
my heart's not in it today, so
I'm gonna give you just one
chance to run for your life.
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
你知道吗，通常我一看到
你们人类就会冲上去
疯狂挥砍，但今天
我心情不好，所以
给你一次逃命的机会。

scripts.text: Talk about Phendark.
scripts.translation: 谈谈芬达克。

scripts.text: Run for your life.
scripts.translation: 逃命。

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
What th--? You know the
same Phendark I know?
Dayam, that's weird. But
yeah, him and Zealotus have
some kind of... I dunno what
it is, actually. Um, love?
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
什...？你认识
我认识的那个芬达克？
哇，真奇怪。不过
是的，他和泽洛图斯
之间有点...我不知道
那是什么。嗯，爱情？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Anyway, Phendark has
been acting really weird
lately. I guess Zealotus
loved him to the point that
she abused him to the point
that he's scared of humans now.
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
总之，芬达克最近
行为很古怪。我想
泽洛图斯爱他爱到
虐待他，以至于
他现在害怕人类了。

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Huh. You know what'd help?
Dark Crystal Fragments. It's
worthless to humans, but if
creatures of darkness eat it,
it brings out more of their
inner demon. Scary, huh?
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
嗯。你知道什么
会有帮助吗？
黑色水晶碎片。这对人类
毫无价值，但如果
黑暗生物吃了它，
就会激发出它们
内心的恶魔。很可怕，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Since Phendark's pretty big, and he's acting like a total wuss, you
you should probably get him to eat ^3131FF369 Dark Crystal Fragments^000000. Don't
worry, you should be able to find those all over Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
既然芬达克体型很大，而且表现得像个胆小鬼，
你应该让他吃^3131FF369黑色水晶碎片^000000。
别担心，你应该能在米德加尔特各地找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
I dunno why a human
like you would want to
help one of us out, though.
What's in it for you, exactly?
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
不过，我搞不懂像你这样的人类
为什么会想帮助我们。
你到底图什么？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
That's right!
Run, get outta here!
If you're not fast enough,
I might eat you, human!
...Well... Probably not.
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
没错！
快跑，赶紧离开这里！
如果你跑得不够快，
我可能会吃掉你，人类！
...嗯...大概不会吧。

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
I don't get why someone
like you, a seemingly heroic
adventurer, would want to help
out Phendark? Did Zealotus
blackmail you or something?
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
我不明白像你这样看似英勇的冒险者，
为什么要帮助芬达克？
是泽洛图斯威胁你了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Well, you could
probably help him
by getting him to eat
^3131FF369 Dark Crystal Fragments^000000
to sort of stir up the demon
that sleeping within, you know?
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
嗯，你大概可以通过让他吃
^3131FF369黑色水晶碎片^000000
来激发他内心沉睡的恶魔，
以此来帮助他，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Feeding him all of those
Dark Crystal Fragments didn't
work? But that was supposed
to be foolproof! Dayam, what
the hell happened to Phendark's
inner demon?! Man oh man...
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
喂给他那么多黑色水晶碎片
都没用吗？但那应该是万无一失的！
哇，芬达克内心的恶魔到底怎么了？
天哪...

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Well, I don't know what
else you could try. I mean,
maybe you could try motivating
him. Reverse psychology?
It's weird talking about this
with a human. Hahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
嗯，我不知道你还能尝试什么。
我是说，也许你可以试着激励他。
反向心理战术？
和人类谈论这些真奇怪。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Phendark sure looks
tough, but I guess even
he isn't totally evil. Yeah.
We monsters aren't all
bad... Just mostly bad.
scripts.translation:
[里比奥]
芬达克看起来很凶悍，
但我想他也不是完全邪恶的。是的。
我们魔物不全是坏的...只是大部分很坏。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Oh man...
It's almost lunchtime,
but he hasn't come by
yet. Where could h--Oh!
Hello, welcome to Einbroch~
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
天哪...
快吃午饭了，
但他还没来。他在哪...哦！
你好，欢迎来到艾音布罗克~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Wait a sec, that
Crunch Toast! You must
be the guy who helped out
my buddy, Kasis. I owe you
my gratitude since without your help, I wouldn't eat lunch!
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
等一下，那个土司！
你一定是帮助了我朋友卡西斯的那个人。
我很感激你，因为如果没有你的帮助，我就没饭吃了！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
It sounds like Kasis
has been having business
troubles lately, but I'm sure
he'll weather it out. I just don't know what's taking him so long
to get here. I'm sooo hungry!
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
听起来卡西斯最近生意不太好，
但我相信他能挺过去的。我只是不知道他为什么这么久还没来。
我好饿啊！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
By any chance, are you
heading to Juno? I have
a favor to ask if you're
going there. Or did you
need help finding your
way around this city?
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
请问，你是要去朱诺吗？如果你要去的话，我有件事想拜托你。
或者你需要我帮你在这座城市里找路吗？

scripts.text: Sure, I'm heading to Juno.
scripts.translation: 好的，我要去朱诺。

scripts.text: I need help finding my way around!
scripts.translation: 我需要帮忙找路！

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Well, if you're going to
Juno and you're not busy,
would you visit a pastry
chef named Kasis for me?
He's an old friend and I'm
a little worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
嗯，如果你要去朱诺而且不忙的话，
能帮我拜访一下名叫卡西斯的糕点厨师吗？
他是我的老朋友，我有点担心他。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Usually, he sends us
lunches around this time
without fail, but since lunch
hasn't arrived yet, I can't help but wonder, ''What happened?''
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
通常，他都会在这个时间准时给我们送午餐，
但既然午餐还没到，我不禁会想，“发生什么事了？”

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Of course, I'd be lying if
I said my hunger didn't factor
into my concern for his welfare. Anyway, if you have the time,
you can find Kasis in Juno's
Bakery. Thanks, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
当然，如果我说我的饥饿感没有影响我对他安危的担忧，那是在撒谎。总之，如果你有时间的话，
你可以在朱诺的面包店找到卡西斯。谢谢，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
First of all, if you
go just outside of the
Airport, you can find
Guides that can tell you
about all the important
places of interest in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
首先，如果你走出机场，
你可以找到向导，他们可以告诉你艾音布罗克所有重要的景点。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Now, if you want to take
a rest before or after a
flight on one of the Airships,
you can use the passenger
lounge on the second floor.
It's a good tip to know~
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
现在，如果你想在乘坐飞空艇之前或之后休息一下，
你可以使用二楼的候机室。
这是一个不错的小贴士~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Did you have any
other questions to ask
me while you're here?
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
你在这里还有别的问题要问我吗？

scripts.text: Can I take a picture with you?
scripts.translation: 能和你合个影吗？

scripts.text: About Einbroch
scripts.translation: 关于艾音布罗克

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Pardon me?
I don't hear that
request often, but
I suppose it couldn't
do any harm to pose
for just one picture.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
请问？
这种要求我还真很少听到，
不过拍一张照片应该也无妨。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Cheese~
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
茄子~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
You know, it's hard to
believe that Einbroch has
become a major industrial
so quickly. I guess it's the
result of the demand for the
ores mined over in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
你知道吗，很难相信艾音布罗克
这么快就成为了一个主要的工业城市。
我想这大概是因为艾音贝赫那边
开采矿石的需求所致吧。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Although Einbech and Einbroch
can't survive without each other, Einbech is in a pretty sorry state
compared to Einbroch. If you've
ever been there, you know what
I mean. It's almost tragic.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
虽然艾音贝赫和艾音布罗克
谁也离不开谁，但和艾音布罗克相比，
艾音贝赫的状况相当糟糕。
如果你去过那里，你就明白我的意思了。
简直有点令人悲哀。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Most of the prosperity of
this city is attributed to the
productivity of the factories.
But along with great wealth,
these factories have also
brought pollution problems.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
这座城市的繁荣主要归功于
工厂的高生产力。
但伴随着巨大的财富，
这些工厂也带来了污染问题。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
If you hear the
Smog Alert, you should
run to safety as quickly
as you can! It's dangerous
to be out in the open when
the pollution levels are high!
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
如果你听到烟雾警报，
应该尽快跑到安全的地方！
在污染水平高的时候待在户外是很危险的！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Well then, I hope
that you enjoy your
travels here in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
那么，希望你在艾音布罗克的
旅行愉快。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Have a good time in
Einbroch, adventurer.
I hope you enjoy your
travels here in the
Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[基里舒]
祝你在艾音布罗克玩得开心，冒险者。
希望你在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的
旅行愉快。
